purpose: Backbone repair for the MycoSci mushroom catalog — retrieval from the GBIF backbone + Index Fungorum.
schema: records[] match data/species.json exactly; if_enrichment{} mirrors mushroom-if-enrichment.json; provenance{} is out-of-band and NOT merged
rules_honoured: GBIF species/match asserted matchType == EXACT before any usageKey was used (2 FUZZY and 3 HIGHERRANK/NONE results were refused, not used)
Index Fungorum queried with AnywhereInText; multi-record binomials disambiguated by CURRENT-NAME-RECORD-NUMBER self-reference, never exact[0]
GBIF sub-endpoints paged on endOfRecords (no count field)
edibility is 'unknown' on every record; reference-list membership was NOT treated as an edibility source
